# Two mixers for the flat

I bake at home, mostly at weekends. The kitchen is small: one free cupboard shelf and about 40 cm of spare worktop.

## A: Nordhaven HM-200 hand mixer, £42

- Size and weight: 1.1 kg, fits in a drawer
- Washing: the two beaters clip out and go in the dishwasher
- Running: you hold it while it mixes
- Dough: two dough hooks come with it, but the booklet limits it to 500 g of flour and 3 minutes at a time
- Guarantee: two years

## B: Valdemar KS-5 stand mixer, £129

- Size and weight: 9.5 kg, 22 x 35 x 36 cm, too big for the shelf so it stays on the worktop
- Washing: the bowl, beater and dough hook go in the dishwasher
- Running: it runs on its own, hands free
- Dough: kneads up to 1.2 kg of flour, with no time limit
- Guarantee: two years
